name: Helcular's Revenge
summary: In Tarren Mill, Helcular's Revenge turns on Thaivand's vow of vengeance. Master Helcular, a great wizard near becoming a lich, was killed by a human lynching crowd after it found his ritual lair in the hills. Before vengeance falls on Southshore, Thaivand needs Helcular's Rod, which he believes one of the yeti holds.

sections.title: A Master Interrupted
sections.body: Master Helcular was near becoming a lich when a human lynching crowd found his ritual lair in the hills and killed him. They buried his body in the Southshore cemetery. Thaivand, his apprentice, finds this treatment of a great wizard unacceptable. He vows that Southshore will face vengeance.

sections.title: The Missing Rod
sections.body: Thaivand says Helcular's Rod must be found first. Yeti have taken over the ritual lair, and Thaivand is sure one of them has the rod. So many yeti roam the region that the search will be difficult. You can find them at Growless Cave and Darrow Hill.

faq.answer: Master Helcular was a great wizard near becoming a lich. A human lynching crowd found his ritual lair in the hills, killed him, and buried his body in the Southshore cemetery.

faq.q: Why does Novice Thaivand want Helcular's Rod?
faq.answer: Thaivand, Helcular's apprentice, plans vengeance upon Southshore. He says the rod must be found first.
Yeti have taken over Helcular's ritual lair, and Thaivand is sure one of them has the rod. You can find yeti at Growless Cave and Darrow Hill.

aliases: where to turn in helculars revenge
faq.answer: Novice Thaivand is in Tarren Mill, in the Hillsbrad Foothills.

angles.text: As a Horde adventurer, you hear from Thaivand in Tarren Mill.
